name: Gallery Prop
prompt:
Create ONE detailed source-compatible reusable GAME ROOM DECOR REFERENCE SHEET. Title INT-GALLERY-PROP-001 — GALLERY & MEMORY DISPLAY DECOR. Exactly TWELVE clean isolated main prop cells in4x3 grid. One main three-quarter or broad-face illustration plus one small useful REAR, UNDERSIDE or OPEN/contact view of SAME object per cell. Short D01–D12 suffix and readable NAME beside each item; full sheet ID in header. Dimensions W,D,H in metres marked PROPOSED, objects may have independent illustration scales. Plain ivory studio background, even light, no humans, rooms, scenery, unlabeled extras or merged objects. Match supplied GEN-24 furniture vocabulary: ivory and rose-veined marble, slender muted gold rose/star/lotus detail, restrained indigo and blush accents. Preserve physical structure and show clear contacts, openings and true back thickness. No generic Gothic arch attached to tiny accessories. Complete tabletop/furniture objects stay human sized, small hardware remains tiny. Empty frames and glass displays must have real clear negative space. These are new source-compatible types, not recovered measured geometry.

INT-GALLERY-PROP-001-D01 — Portrait wall frame. Proposed W,D,H [1.2, 0.1, 1.6]m. One empty portrait WALL FRAME, ivory/gold rose-star carving, completely EMPTY central aperture with backing removed. Show rear hanging eyelets and frame thickness; no portrait, mirror, glass painting or wall.

INT-GALLERY-PROP-001-D02 — Small album display stand. Proposed W,D,H [0.5, 0.4, 0.8]m. One small tabletop album DISPLAY STAND, tilted flat book-rest tray, simple support triangle and two low front retaining tabs. Not a complete easel, book or lectern with giant columns.

INT-GALLERY-PROP-001-D03 — Memory display cabinet. Proposed W,D,H [1.3, 0.5, 1.6]m. One glazed memory DISPLAY CABINET, ivory/gold frame with clear glass door and two visible empty shelves. Show rear enclosure and clear door hinge side. No framed artwork or gifts inside.

INT-GALLERY-PROP-001-D04 — Sculpture plinth. Proposed W,D,H [0.6, 0.6, 1.1]m. One plain small sculpture PLINTH, rose/ivory marble rectangular shaft on low foot, fine gold edge bands, level empty top. No sculpture, room or column capital.

INT-GALLERY-PROP-001-D05 — Picture light bracket. Proposed W,D,H [0.4, 0.25, 0.2]m. One compact PICTURE LIGHT bracket: narrow gold horizontal light hood on two thin arms connected to a small flat wall plate. Show rear screw seats; no picture frame or full room attached.

INT-GALLERY-PROP-001-D06 — Keepsake box. Proposed W,D,H [0.3, 0.2, 0.15]m. One shallow rectangular keepsake ARCHIVE BOX, ivory/blush timber with small label slot and flat hinged lid. Larger flat footprint, no jeweled crown or lotus feet; distinct from the new personal jewel casket. Small open view shows empty box.

INT-GALLERY-PROP-001-D07 — Hinged album. Proposed W,D,H [0.35, 0.25, 0.05]m. One hinged MEMORY ALBUM open slightly to show thick cover, page block and hinge spine, blank inset picture mounts only. No specific family portraits or photographs.

INT-GALLERY-PROP-001-D08 — Carved gallery wall plaque. Proposed W,D,H [0.6, 0.08, 0.4]m. One carved gallery WALL PLAQUE, shallow rose-marble oval with fine gold star/rose border and empty indigo centre for future inscription. Flat rear with two fixing holes, no wall chunk.

INT-GALLERY-PROP-001-D09 — Display shelf corner. Proposed W,D,H [0.6, 0.6, 0.15]m. One90-degree DISPLAY SHELF corner with two flat wall contact edges and visible thickness, ivory/rose top and gold edge molding. No whole cabinet or standing legs.

INT-GALLERY-PROP-001-D10 — Freestanding easel frame. Proposed W,D,H [0.65, 0.65, 1.6]m. One freestanding DISPLAY EASEL FRAME: empty ornate rectangular portrait frame on two front legs plus ONE rear prop leg. Show front and rear support, no canvas, painting or working-easel adjustment rack. Distinct from atelier H-frame easel.

INT-GALLERY-PROP-001-D11 — Small specimen bell jar. Proposed W,D,H [0.25, 0.25, 0.5]m. One clear SPECIMEN BELL JAR with removable dome, small gold top knob and low rose-marble round base. EMPTY inside, glass visibly transparent, not a crystal lantern or animal habitat.

INT-GALLERY-PROP-001-D12 — Gallery bench arm trim. Proposed W,D,H [0.12, 0.45, 0.25]m. One separate BENCH ARM TRIM applique, curved gold rose-scroll profile with flat inner mounting face and two pegs. No bench, seat cushion or human arm included.
Footer: Proposed reference objects; anatomy-free props only; view parity, moving parts and mesh separation require model review.

visual_review_notes: Twelve gallery/display props are present, with clear glass cabinet and empty bell jar, empty frame fronts, open archive box, album views and rear mounting pegs for bench-arm trim. Palette follows the original palace.

D01 and D10 rear views add a solid backing panel although their front apertures are empty. Treat backing as optional/removable and keep intended empty frame openings clear; image does not prove exact front/back correspondence.

Picture-light arms, glass thickness, shelf wall contacts and easel stability require actual modeling review. Display-easel frame is a different form from the atelier working easel, not a duplicate painting mesh.
